name: Improved Marching Cubes Algorithm
definition: A 3D reconstruction technique for CT images that modifies the traditional MC algorithm in three aspects: voxel representation, interpolation method, and triangular mesh simplification, to improve operation efficiency and real-time interaction.
summary: The Improved Marching Cubes Algorithm enhances 3D reconstruction by expanding topology cases to prevent voids, using tunable interpolation and larger voxels for efficiency.
